notes.title: God's Continent Strategy
notes.content:
I. Recommended Early-Game Hero Lineups
Game heroes are divided into three races: Human, Demon, and Beast, each with its own counter-strike. Here are some introductions:

1. Dracula: Mage. High spell damage and lifesteal, the top choice for early-game pushes.

2. Shyvana: Berserker. Super high physical damage.

3. Maria: Priestess. An indispensable healer for every raid.

4. Trilsi: Marksman. A must-have hero for the start of the game, with a full-screen ultimate and essential for pushing maps.

5. Miyamoto Musashi: Assassin. Single-target burst damage.

6. Garuda: Marksman. Full-screen skills, excellent for pushing maps.


II. Lineup Matchups
Currently, the core is the Demon. You can trade Demon cards for the Tower of Terror. Try to farm as many Terrors as possible, so you can grow quickly.

1. Poison Bow (Trishir) and Karama are top picks. Poison Bow deals high critical damage and has a poison effect, which ignores defense and silences the enemy. Karama has 20 dodge at level 91, and its passive also increases dodge. Dodge isn't calculated based on a normal percentage! The actual dodge effect at level 91 is around 70%, but with its low-health passive, it can reach 90% dodge. Karama's damage is multi-stage and its health regeneration is high, making it practically the tankiest card. It can also steal energy from enemies with the highest attack power, preventing them from using their ultimates. These two also scale the fastest, especially since you can trade for Tower of Terror, so the chance of winning is high.

2. Uriel: Immune to most control. Available from level 70. Her skills ignore defense. As monsters with higher defense become more vulnerable, her damage is higher than a level 140 Poison Bow. At level 70, she's practically the highest-damaging character in the late game. By level 100, she's fully developed. The added dodge at level 91 rivals Karama's, and with more dodges, she becomes quite tanky. Only Karama and Uriel have added dodge at level 91. Although recently nerfed, she still deals the most damage, both ignoring defense and allowing her to harvest low health.

3. Skadi: Ice Maiden: The strongest control card and a core card in competitive play. Whoever has the faster Ice Maiden has a better chance of winning. She's also very useful in dungeons, allowing her to constantly control a single card, and her ultimate can even control a group. If the opponent doesn't have Uriel's freeze immunity, they're essentially just standing there and taking the beating. Available at level 90.

4. Other characters with fast growth: Arthur, Maria, Zhao Yun, Hydra, Leto, and Birdman. Use whoever you like the most.

5. All Royal cards can be used, it just depends on the level. Later, if you have the conditions, you can get the God Card Athena. Elf King is not recommended. Don't touch it unless you're a big spender. Maintaining two God Cards will take you half a year.

6. Recommended lineup:

Low- to mid-level spenders: Early game: Poison Bow, Karama, and Zhao Yun. These three are fixed. The other cards can be combined with any card.

Mid-game: Poison Bow, Karama, Ice Maiden, Leto, Maria/Druid, and 90 Gandalf.

Late-game: Ideally, you'll have a level 90 Angel Uriel, a level 90 Angel Uriel, Poison Bow/max-level Lilith (depending on luck), Druid, a level 120 Gandalf, Opala, and Ice Maiden.


III. Advanced Details
1. Diamond Usage. Applicable to v0 to v10

1.1. Don't use diamonds recklessly. Buying Stamina twice a day is optimal, but not buying isn't a big deal. Currently, no new gameplay is available after level 55.

1.2. Then there's the ranked match in 15 days. This is currently an event comparable to diamonds, and the rewards are decent. Use it based on the regional situation.

1.3. Long-term players can try saving up Heroic Spirit scrolls. Heroic Spirits become permanent after seven days, and each Heroic Spirit cycle lasts seven days. The chance of getting a good card is high with 30 Heroic Spirit scrolls. Don't waste them on single draws. It takes about five weeks to save up, and you can buy them after the refresh is around 30% off. It costs about 90,000 diamonds to save up for 400 Heroic Spirit scrolls. 400 draws will give you about 2-5 legendary cards, and the chance of getting a Royal card is also high. I'm considered lucky, getting 4 Royals and 8 Royals. Of course, some people only get 2 legendary cards, but the lowest I know of is 2, so it's not a big loss. A Royal card costs 30,000 diamonds at the auction house.

2. Equipment

2.1. You need to farm for equipment skills. Level 20 equipment dungeons yield the most skills, such as the Invincible Blade and Dual Blade. These skills can be farmed, but it's not recommended to farm them constantly, as you won't be able to keep up with the star level of the equipment. You can try this later if you need skills.

2.2. For those equipment stones, 60 can be exchanged for a piece of premium equipment. It's best to save them up and unlock them at higher levels. They're not necessary before level 80.

2.3. Recommended Enhancement Priority:

Light Armor > Magic Armor > Heavy Armor

Weapons > Boots > Other

3. Exotic Beasts

3.1: Exotic Beasts add very powerful stats, and there's a huge difference between common players and high-rollers. Red Exotic Beasts can be obtained primarily from the leaderboards. Try to get in the top three. You can still get them later, but the chances are lower. Prioritize red Exotic Beasts for cultivation. Recommended red Exotic Beasts are Monkeys and orange Gorillas. If you encounter an Exotic Beast that doesn't mutate, cultivate it to full capacity before cultivating it. If you can't cultivate it, switch to another culturable beast to enter the cultivation interface, then switch to the fully cultivated one to cultivate it.

notes.title: "God's Continent" is now officially released!!!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers:

Welcome to "God's Continent"! After meticulous preparation, this strategy card game is now officially online! Step into a magical world filled with fantasy and adventure!In this mysterious continent, humans, beasts, and demons are constantly at war, and the forces of darkness are quietly rising, threatening world peace. You will shoulder the heavy responsibility of saving the God's Continent. During your adventure, recruit powerful heroes from each of the three races and assemble your own invincible team.


[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45674573/f91e3e6b30c992c7849c363c64c3324dfa7d425b.jpg"]


To celebrate the game's launch, we've prepared a generous promotion:


godvip666

godvip777

godvip888



How to claim: Copy the redemption code - Click the in-game avatar - Redeem the gift pack

Join our QQ group (1003273757), Discord, and community discussion group to receive special gift packs


[hr][/hr] Game Features:
- Rich Hero Roster: Hundreds of heroes from different races, each with unique skills and attributes, await your recruitment. Human Mages excel at elemental manipulation, Orc Warriors possess incredible strength and defense, and Demon Assassins can deliver devastating blows from the shadows. Combine them strategically to unleash your full potential.



- Deep Strategy: Every battle is a test of wits. Consider hero synergies, skill combinations, and positioning to develop unique tactics for each enemy. Cleverly utilize terrain and the environment to defeat the strong with the weak, and experience the unique charm of strategy card games.



- Vast World to Explore: The Continent of Gods boasts a vast map, from tranquil forests to blazing volcanoes, from mysterious ruins to frozen snow-capped mountains. Every region hides untold challenges and treasures. Explore the world, unlock new plots and quests, and discover powerful heroes and mysterious items hidden in every corner.



- Social Interactive Adventure: Team up with other players to challenge powerful bosses together and share adventure experiences and resources. Join a guild and participate in fierce Guild Wars for glory and rewards. Communicate in the World Channel to meet like-minded friends and form the strongest alliance together.



 
Adventurers, are you ready to embark on this magical journey full of challenges and surprises? Join "God's Continent", assemble your strongest team, fight against darkness, save the world, and write your own legendary story!

notes.title: Postponement announcement
notes.content:
